# Leah Turner

 +44 7700 900023

## CV Manchester, England

Profile I have worked in shops, markets and a small delivery counter. The jobs were not all long, but I learned to listen, sort out everyday problems and keep customers updated. I am looking for a steadier role where I can be useful to a team and learn the products properly. Experience 2023 – Present **Sales Assistant**, *Greenbank Homeware*, Manchester

- Helps customers compare household products and checks stock before promising availability.
- Handles returns and delivery queries, passing unusual cases to the supervisor.
- Keeps shelf labels and short product notes up to date.
2021 – 2023 **Market Stall Assistant**, *Northern Pantry*, Manchester

- Served customers, prepared orders and tracked payments.
- Coordinated with nearby stallholders when weather or supply changes affected opening.
2019 – 2021 **Customer Assistant**, *City Parcel Point*, Manchester

- Accepted parcels, checked labels and explained collection steps.
- Logged items needing a second check and helped keep the counter organized.
Selected contribution Shares a morning update with other market stallholders on stock, opening times and weather changes so customers can be directed accurately. Practical skills Service Customer support, returns, Retail POS, stock checks, order delivery queries operations preparation Languages English native · Urdu conversational

Education and availability Secondary education, Manchester (completed 2018). Full-time availability; open to retail shifts in Greater Manchester. A short gap between roles is not detailed here.

Leah Turner November 11, 2026
